the card leaves the game, and every deck's draft. restore: undo a suspension.

Deletes an account for good (v0.4.1, api/accounts.py): its sign-in, profile, sessions,
roles and decks go; its game results, wins and tokens stay, as "Deleted player". Refused 409
while it plays a game. The account's game lock is held meanwhile, so no game of it starts.

schema.title: Response Account Packs Api V1 Admin Users  User Id  Packs Get

post.description: SysOp gives unopened packs to any account, its own included: with a reason, audited.

SysOp resets an account to a new one's state (v0.4.5, api/resets.py), so the setup wizard
runs again: its handle, alliance, library and packs are cleared, its decks go to the trash,
and its wins and tokens go back to 0 and 1,000; its friends, messages and reports stay.
Refused 409 while it plays a game or sits at an open table. The account's game lock is held
meanwhile, as for a deletion, so no game of it starts.

get.description: An account's balance and latest entries, for administrators and SysOp.

post.description:
SysOp gives tokens to any account, its own included, or takes them back: a ledger entry of
its own, apart from tokens earned, with the reason, and audited (PROG03).

SysOp sets an account's wins, and so its level: any player's, or its own. The setting is a
ledger entry of its own, apart from counted wins, with the reason, and is audited (PROG03).

get.description:
The transfer market: live auctions, never the viewer's own unless asked, filtered and
sorted; bids count as the current bid, else the starting bid.

Lists copies of one edition in one finish, an auction each: they leave the library at once.
A retried request (the same key) lists nothing more and answers with what it listed.

The transfer list: the viewer's auctions, live, sold, and unsold ones to relist.

What the viewer may list, by edition and finish, by name: copies granted to it, less those
listed; for SysOp, any printing the game can play, in each finish it was printed in.

post.description: Hides the won or the lost auctions from the transfer targets.

delete.description: The seller withdraws the auction, until its first bid: the copy comes back.

A bid: held from the balance at once, the leading bid returned to its bidder; at or above
Buy Now it buys at Buy Now; in the last 30 seconds it pushes the end to 30 seconds away.
Buys at the Buy Now price: the auction ends at once, the leading bid returned.
A new auction for an unsold auction's copy, if the library still holds it.

printing chosen in your own seat's deck. The first request for a card waits while it is
fetched. 404 card_image_missing for cards Scryfall does not know, such as tokens. 429
card_images_busy when the account already waits for many new cards, and 503 when everyone
does or Scryfall asked us to wait; both carry Retry-After.

Giant table (v0.5.1) also your team; a change of deck or team makes your teammate not ready

under their limit of running games. The reply names the game; each player plays it over its
